text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a flat ring from 4 mm steel plate: 348 mm inside and 408 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside diameter (jigsaw with a metal blade, or a cutting shop).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 9 mm holes on a 378 mm diameter, opposite each other.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File the inner edge smooth; paint with heat-resistant paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: it lies on the two holder arms, one M8 bolt into each;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the cooker drops through it and hangs by its two handles.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The jacket clears the inner edge by 5 mm all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cooker body and jacket pass through without touching.
